headline: U.S. debt tops $40 trillion. And, new census report Trump is touting raises concerns
context: The U.S. debt has surpassed $40 trillion. And, a new census report on noncitizen voting that President Trump is touting has ties to a think tank aligned with him, raising concerns among experts.
